title: 第一卷 第11章 跟着去赶海
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
张秋月问道：“那你打算怎么做？”

    李华随口道：“还没想好，不过我已经和她约了今天在礁石滩见面。”

    “她要是不来呢？”

    “她不敢不来。”

    “那……有了，你带她去礁石滩赶海，那边危险，稍有不注意就有可能摔得头破血流。”

    “……”李华眯起了眼睛，暗骂这个女人蛇蝎心肠。

    “李华，你懂我的意思吧？”

    “懂。”

    看到李华点头，张秋月露出笑容。

    看起来是她想多了，李华还是之前那个李华，依然对他言听计从。

    犹豫再三，还是把早餐给了李华。

    她没回家。

    而是往码头走。

    她没钱再买早餐，但可以找人给她买。

    ……

    李华拿出一个包子塞到嘴里吃了起来。

    香啊。

    这年头的包子那可是真材实料，没有一点科技与狠活。

    正吃着，阿青跑了过来，还拿了几个鸡蛋：“华哥，你吃着啦，这么丰盛啊。”

    李华：“张秋月给的。”

    阿青一脸惊讶：“她给你买的？”

    “嗯，算是吧。”

    阿青挠了挠头，怀疑自己是不是耳朵出了问题。

    李华给他一根油条：“你还没吃饭吗？吃吧。”

    阿青接过来，把鸡蛋放下：“哥，那你吃鸡蛋。”

    “好。”李华应了一声，起身走到屋里，把鞋子下面的钱拿出来，说道：“对了，这些钱是你放的吧。”

    阿青点点头。

    “你拿回去。”

    “华哥，你欠了张大雷那么多钱……”

    “等会去赶海，赚了钱就能还上。”

    “哥，你别开玩笑了。”

    “谁和你开玩笑了。”

    阿青挠头，一脸不解：“赶海才能赚几个钱啊……”

    “华哥，我知道这些钱不多，肯定帮不上你的忙，但这是我的心意，你就拿着吧。”

    “你是不是嫌弃……”

    李华听他这么说，把钱揣口袋里，说道：“阿青，你这死脑筋，有时候也挺让人头疼的。”

    “那这样，等会咱们去赶海，得搞点装备。”

    “这钱，就算是你入股。”

    “等卖钱了，咱们五五分。”

    阿青摇头：“我不要，我没欠钱。”

    “……”李华搂住他的脖子：“废什么话，先去小卖铺买装备。”

    到了小卖铺。

    老板也姓李，是本家族叔。

    李华招呼了一声。

    买了草帽，花露水，抄网，手套，网兜，杂七杂八的加起来，正好花了五十块钱。
content_en:
Zhang Qiuyue asked: "Then what are you going to do?"

    Li Hua said casually: "I haven't thought about it yet, but I have made an appointment with her to meet at the reef beach today."

    "What if she doesn't come?"

    "She didn't dare not come."

    "Then... OK, you take her to the reef beach to catch the sea. It's dangerous there. If you don't pay attention, you may fall and get a bloody head."

    "..." Li Hua narrowed his eyes and secretly scolded this woman for being cruel.

    "Li Hua, do you understand what I mean?"

    "Understood."

    Seeing Li Hua nod, Zhang Qiuyue smiled.

    It seemed that she was overthinking it. Li Hua was still the same Li Hua as before and still obeyed his words.

    After much hesitation, he gave breakfast to Li Hua.

    She didn't go home.

    Instead, walk toward the pier.

    She didn't have money to buy another breakfast, but she could find someone to buy it for her.

    …

    Li Hua took out a bun and stuffed it into his mouth and started eating.

    Fragrant.

    These days' steamed buns are made from real ingredients, without any technology or hard work.

    While eating, Ah Qing ran over and took a few eggs: "Brother Hua, you are eating, it is so rich."

    Li Hua: "Given by Zhang Qiuyue."

    Ah Qing looked surprised: "She bought it for you?"

    "Well, that's right."

    Ah Qing scratched his head, wondering if there was something wrong with his ears.

    Li Hua gave him a fried dough stick: "You haven't eaten yet? Eat it."

    Ah Qing took it and put the egg down: "Brother, then you eat the egg."

    "Okay." Li Hua responded, got up, walked into the house, took out the money from under his shoes, and said, "By the way, you should have put the money there."

    Ah Qing nodded.

    "Take it back."

    "Brother Hua, you owe Zhang Dalei so much money..."

    "I'll go to sea later and I can pay it back after making money."

    "Brother, stop joking."

    "Who are you kidding?"

    Ah Qing scratched his head and looked puzzled: "How much money can you make just by traveling to sea..."

    "Brother Hua, I know this money is not much, and it certainly won't help you, but this is what I want, so just take it."

    "Are you disgusted with..."

    After hearing what he said, Li Hua put the money in his pocket and said, "Ah Qing, you are so stubborn, sometimes it is quite a headache."

    "Well, let's go to sea later and get some equipment."

    "This money is considered your investment."

    "When the money comes from selling it, we'll give it 50-50."

    Ah Qing shook his head: "I don't want it, I don't owe money."

    "..." Li Hua hugged his neck: "What nonsense, go to the small shop to buy equipment first."

    Arrived at the small shop.

    The boss’s surname is also Li, and he is an uncle in the same family.

    Li Hua greeted.

    I bought a straw hat, toilet water, a fishing net, gloves, and a net bag. All in all, I spent exactly fifty yuan.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 11 Follow to catch the sea
